why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.2 draft with the keyboard fix

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Fixed
- A WoWFA window that was first shown in a fight could take the keyboard and swallow every key (the character could not walk). The game does not let an addon set the pass-the-keys flag in a fight, so such a window now does not take the keyboard at all (its close button still works). A window that was opened out of combat keeps Esc as before.

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- The copy buttons copy by themselves when the client has a copy function. The chat font no longer flips in fights. Time lines with the client's plural escape match. Boosted Rest, four NPC names and two more game lines are in Persian.
- The trace and the timers in the report. A module switched off in a fight comes back after it.
- Small page of the icon, update and new tags, the buffs switch with a preview, the experimental combat option, the game windows switch OFF by default.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat unless the combat option is turned on.
